title: Embedding a machine action
statement: Given an injective map from $m$ work-tape indices into $k$ indices, an optional sink tape, and an action on $m$ work tapes, define an action on $k$ work tapes. The input-head movement and successor state are unchanged; mapped tapes retain their original instructions, while other tapes are left blank and stationary, except that when a sink tape is specified it writes the original action's output symbol there and moves right if that output exists. With a sink tape, the expanded action emits no output; without one, it retains the original output.
hypotheses_covered: An injective map from $m$ work-tape indices into $k$ indices
An optional sink index among the $k$ work tapes
A machine action on $m$ work tapes over a symbol alphabet with a state set
